title: Alien Blaster
body:
"A blast from the past! Shoot those darn space Enemies with ease!"

Description

The Alien Blaster is a weapon that was originally obtainable during the Martian invasion Event for 35,000 scrap from Gleep's Goods. As Gleep's Goods is now a permanent shop, it is obtainable for the same amount of scrap from there. It is a small alien blaster that fires green rectangles. and deals decent damage to a singular target.

the Alien blaster is glitched some users lost their Alien blaster randomly

Tips

  • The Alien Blaster is effective at dealing with Darklings due to its ability to pass through walls.
  • Like every limited item in the game, the Alien Blaster can be purchased from player shops.
  • Uniquely, the Alien Blaster does not have most projectile weapons' lock-on, making it less effective for crowd control but better at picking off singular targets.
